[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&color=black)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/better-animations) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&color=black)](https://modrinth.com/organization/cre8to-team) [![Feedback](https://img.shields.io/badge/feedback%20form%20(no%20login)-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=googleforms&color=indigo)](https://forms.gle/fkgMp6YroGjwH8Nr5) [![Donate@CupOfCoffee](https://img.shields.io/badge/donate%20a%20cup%20of%20coffee-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon&color=black)](https://patreon.com/cre8to) **Better Expressions** 已遷移！請前往[這裡](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-expressions)取得！ ## 📘 描述 *極致流暢！* 全面改寫你的 Minecraft 玩家動畫，讓它們栩栩如生！ 與幾乎所有動畫模組相容！包含 Better Combat、Quark、Emotecraft 表情動作以及 Parcool！ 同時支援 **Fabric** 與 **Forge** ## ⚙️ 安裝方式 * 從版本選單下載最新的 `Better_Animations.zip` 檔案。 * 從**相依性**選單下載所需的模組。 * 將模組與資源包放入對應資料夾。（例如 `%appdata%/.minecraft/`） * 在遊戲內的**資源包**選單中啟用該資源包。 ## ❗ 相依性 [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)、[Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)、[Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) ## 📜 貢獻者 [MincraftEinstein](https://modrinth.com/user/MincraftEinstein)、[Qboi](https://modrinth.com/user/Qboi)、Prairies、Mysty、SomeOddBall、Brosiyeah、YaBoiMoh、Quackinsons、Jeanne ## 🧩 相容性 **可搭配使用！** — ﻿[playerAnimator](https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator)、[Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat)、[Emotecraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/emotecraft)、[Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark)、[3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers)、[ParCool!](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool)、[Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations)、[First-person Model](https://modrinth.com/mod/first-person-model) **無法搭配使用：(** — Improved Animations、[Serious Player Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/serious-player-animations) 以及 EMF+ETF 以外的任何 CEM 模型模組
